item.title: [ransomware] AI-assisted Slopoly malware powers Hive0163’s ransomware campaigns
item.description: The Hive0163 group used AI-assisted malware called Slopoly to maintain persistent access in ransomware attacks. IBM X-Force researchers report that the financially motivated group Hive0163 is using AI-assisted malware named Slopoly to maintain persistent access during ransomware attacks, showing how threat actors can quickly build new malware frameworks using AI. item.title: [ransomware] Ransomware Attacks are on the Rise
